Muṣṭika
------------------------------------------
Muṣṭika and Cāṇūra were the most powerful wrestlers in the court of the evil king कṁस. When the latter invited कृष्ण and बलराम to attend a special sacrifice called Dhanuryāga at मथुरा, they obliged. Out of the several stratagems employed by कṁस to kill कृष्ण was to challenge him (and बलराम) for a wrest-ling bout with these two. In the ensuing fight, कृष्ण killed Cāṇūra whereas बलराम finished मुष्टिक.

musala
(‘wooden club’)
------------------------------------------
In वेदिच् सच्रिड़िचेस्, very often, grains will have to be pounded or dehusked. For this, a मुसल is used. It is a wooden pestle made of khadira wood (Acacia catechu) with a metallic head.
Some deities like बलराम (elder brother of कृष्ण) are shown with the मुसल in one of the hands, as a weapon.
